name: Hanging Leg Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip, straight arms, and your legs extended straight down together.
Engage your lats slightly to stabilize your torso and brace your core.
Raise both legs together toward horizontal, curling your pelvis upward only as far as you can control without swinging.
Lower your legs slowly back to the starting hang with full control.
tips: Avoid swinging your torso backward to throw your legs up with momentum.
Pause briefly at the bottom hang if your body starts to sway.
